text_03: How is coaching different from therapy?
text_04: Coaching is future-oriented and focused on goals, habits, and values-based action. It does not involve diagnosis or treatment of mental health conditions. Therapy is designed to address mental health symptoms, trauma, and emotional distress, often exploring past experiences and their impact on your current life.
text_06: Coaching may be a good fit if you’re generally stable but feeling stuck, in transition, or ready to deepen into your values and make concrete changes in your work, relationships, or daily life. It can also be helpful if you want structured support and accountability.
text_07: Where can you work with coaching clients?
text_08: Coaching is available to clients who live outside of California, depending on scheduling and jurisdictional considerations. We will clarify your location and any relevant details during our initial consultation.
text_10: Coaching is not considered medical or mental health treatment and is not covered by health insurance. Coaching fees are typically paid out-of-pocket.
